newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends up, seen in range near term.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends up, seen in range near term.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled firmer but below session highs in a technical bounce that corrected recent sharp losses, floor sources said.
March delivery's dip to 10.10 cents a lb Tuesday from a weekly high of 10.47 cents Monday left several traders confused.
On the one hand, a double bottom at 10.13 cents in March hit Wednesday and Thursday could signal firm support. And technically, the market remains a bit oversold.
"We may get a retracement to the upside, but I don't think we've hit the bottom at 10.10," a trader said.

Resistance was put at 10.40 cents and firmer resistance at a gap between 10.47 and 10.50 cents for March sugar. Prices are expected to trade between 10.10 and 10.40 cents ahead of the contract's expiry in five weeks.
The spot month settled up 0.09 cent at 10.24 cents, traded 10.32 to 10.20 cents. Deferreds finished flat to 0.01 firmer.
Volume was estimated at 20,463 lots, with 1,742 AAs noted.

Dealers cited trade short-covering and outright buying of March, and speculative selling in the May and July contracts. The trade was also a steady seller of the March/May and the March/July spreads, they said.
